title: Can a lie-in make you healthier
paragraphs: Every morning, my alarm goes off, I wake up from my slumber and hit the snooze button. Then I crawl back under my duvet and catch a few more minutes of shut-eye. "I'll go to bed early tonight," I tell myself. But then, in the evening, I get a second wind and completely forget about my early night.
Why am I finding it so difficult to get a good night's sleep? And is it a problem?

The amount we sleep has declined over the years and insomnia is on the rise. Modern technology is often blamed. The light from our smartphone affects levels of melatonin - the sleep-inducing hormone - keeping us wide awake into the early hours.

Lack of sleep can seriously damage our health and memory. We need deep sleep to transfer our memories from our short-term storage to our long-term storage. If we don't sleep enough, we may lose those memories. This is particularly disastrous for people studying for exams.

So, how can we learn to sleep better? For Professor Till Roenneberg, it's important people recognise they have an internal body clock. This determines whether you are a night owl, an early bird or somewhere in the middle. We don't have any choice. "It's like feet," he said "Some people are born with big feet and some with small feet, but most people are somewhere in the middle." Our work schedules are out of sync with our natural sleep patterns. He says this leads to "social jetlag" where people feel like they are constantly in the wrong time zone.

Paul Kelley - a sleep expert from the University of Oxford - says that most people are getting up too early. He believes work and school should start a few hours later. Many companies are starting to realise more sleep can mean a more productive workforce and are changing work schedules. While in South Korea, office workers are heading to relaxation parlours at lunchtime to take power naps in hammocks or massage chairs. This is much healthier than catching forty winks while sitting on the toilet or dropping off at their desks.
So, if like me you find yourself hitting your snooze button every morning - don't feel bad. It's just our body clocks!

vocabulary.entry: slumber [n.] /ˈslʌmbə/ 睡眠 (书面语或诗意用语)
vocabulary.example: She fell into a deep slumber after a long day's work.
vocabulary.translation: 经过一整天的工作后，她陷入了沉睡。

vocabulary.entry: snooze button [n.] /snuːz ˈbʌtən/ 贪睡按钮 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: He hit the snooze button three times before finally getting up.
vocabulary.translation: 他按了三次贪睡按钮才终于起床。

vocabulary.entry: crawl [v.] /krɔːl/ 爬行；缓慢移动
vocabulary.example: The injured soldier crawled to safety.
vocabulary.translation: 受伤的士兵爬到了安全的地方。

vocabulary.entry: duvet [n.] /ˈduːveɪ/ 羽绒被 (英式英语，美式通常用 comforter)
vocabulary.example: She wrapped herself in a warm duvet on the cold night.
vocabulary.translation: 寒冷的夜晚，她把自己裹在温暖的羽绒被里。

vocabulary.entry: shut-eye [n.] /ˈʃʌt aɪ/ 睡觉；睡眠 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: I need to get some shut-eye before the early flight.
vocabulary.translation: 在早班飞机前我需要睡一会儿。

vocabulary.entry: second wind [n.] /ˈsekənd wɪnd/ 恢复的精力；重振的精神 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: After a coffee break, he got his second wind and continued working.
vocabulary.translation: 喝咖啡休息后，他恢复了精力，继续工作。

vocabulary.entry: insomnia [n.] /ɪnˈsɒmniə/ 失眠；失眠症 (医学词汇)
vocabulary.example: Stress and anxiety are common causes of insomnia.
vocabulary.translation: 压力和焦虑是失眠的常见原因。

vocabulary.entry: melatonin [n.] /ˌmeləˈtəʊnɪn/ 褪黑素 (生物化学词汇)
vocabulary.example: Melatonin supplements are sometimes used to treat sleep disorders.
vocabulary.translation: 褪黑素补充剂有时用于治疗睡眠障碍。

vocabulary.entry: disastrous [adj.] /dɪˈzɑːstrəs/ 灾难性的；极糟糕的 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The decision had disastrous consequences for the company.
vocabulary.translation: 这个决定给公司带来了灾难性的后果。

vocabulary.entry: out of sync [phr.] /aʊt əv sɪŋk/ 不同步；不协调 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The sound on the video was out of sync with the picture.
vocabulary.translation: 视频的声音和画面不同步。

vocabulary.entry: social jetlag [n.] /ˈsəʊʃəl ˈdʒetlæɡ/ 社交时差 (专业词汇；心理学)
vocabulary.example: Social jetlag occurs when your work schedule conflicts with your natural body clock.
vocabulary.translation: 当你的工作时间表与你自然的生物钟冲突时，就会出现社交时差。

vocabulary.entry: power nap [n.] /ˈpaʊə næp/ 小睡；恢复精力的短睡 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: A 20-minute power nap can boost your energy and concentration.
vocabulary.translation: 20分钟的短时小睡可以提升你的精力和专注力。

vocabulary.entry: forty winks [n. pl.] /ˈfɔːti wɪŋks/ 小睡；打盹 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: I'm going to have forty winks before dinner.
vocabulary.translation: 晚饭前我要小睡一会儿。

vocabulary.entry: drop off [phr.] /drɒp ɒf/ 睡着；打瞌睡 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: He dropped off in front of the television.
vocabulary.translation: 他在电视机前睡着了。

vocabulary.entry: go off [phr.] /ɡəʊ ɒf/ （闹钟等）响起 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: My alarm went off at 6 a.m. as usual.
vocabulary.translation: 我的闹钟照常在早上6点响起。

vocabulary.entry: be blamed [phr.] /biː bleɪmd/ 被责备；归咎于 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The poor harvest was blamed on the bad weather.
vocabulary.translation: 收成不好被归咎于恶劣的天气。

vocabulary.entry: affect [v.] /əˈfekt/ 影响 (动词)
vocabulary.example: The new policy will affect thousands of families.
vocabulary.translation: 新政策将影响到成千上万的家庭。

vocabulary.entry: keep awake [phr.] /kiːp əˈweɪk/ 使保持清醒 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The noise from the party kept me awake all night.
vocabulary.translation: 派对的噪音让我整晚都没睡着。

vocabulary.entry: lead to [phr.] /liːd tuː/ 导致；引起 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.
vocabulary.translation: 摄入过多糖分会导致健康问题。

vocabulary.entry: in the wrong time zone [phr.] /ɪn ðə rɒŋ ˈtaɪm zəʊn/ 处于错误的时区 (固定搭配；比喻)
vocabulary.example: After flying across the Atlantic, he felt like he was in the wrong time zone.
vocabulary.translation: 飞越大西洋后，他感觉自己好像处于错误的时区。

vocabulary.entry: take a nap [phr.] /teɪk ə næp/ 小睡；打盹 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: She likes to take a nap after lunch.
vocabulary.translation: 她喜欢午饭后小睡一会儿。

vocabulary.entry: relaxation parlour [n.] /ˌriːlækˈseɪʃən ˈpɑːlə/ 休闲场所；放松室 (英式拼写，美式: parlor)
vocabulary.example: The office building has a relaxation parlour with massage chairs.
vocabulary.translation: 办公楼里有一个配有按摩椅的休闲室。
